SELECT /*LGVCOM00120.basicUserPopupList*/ om.organization_id ,om.org_name_local AS organization_name ,om.org_name_eng AS english_organization_name FROM org_master om WHERE om.subsidiary_code = #{subsidiary_code}
AND om.organization_id like '%' || UPPER(#{organizationId}) || '%'
AND UPPER(om.org_name_local) like '%' || UPPER(#{organizationName}) || '%'
ORDER BY om.organization_id
